summary: PDF download/share bug verification PASSED. Fix in /app/frontend/src/shared.tsx (switch to expo-file-system/legacy + 'base64' string literal + robust cache dir fallback) resolves the 'Cannot read property base64 of undefined' error. Verified E2E on Expo web preview: manager successfully downloaded PDFs for Quotation (SE-QT-2026-010), Invoice (SE-INV-2026-002), Receipt (SE-RCV-2026-002), and Service Report (SE-SR-2026-002). Employee successfully downloaded a Service Report PDF. In all 5 cases, backend /api/*/pdf returned HTTP 200, the browser triggered an <a download> of the .pdf file, and no base64/undefined error toast or 'PDF failed' toast surfaced. React Native style deprecation warnings (resizeMode/pointerEvents/shadow*) still present from previous iteration — non-blocking, already reported. Backend testing was intentionally skipped per E1 request (PDF endpoints already 22/22 pass in iteration_1).

rca_of_issue: Root cause: expo-file-system v19 (SDK 54) removed the legacy `FileSystem.EncodingType` enum from the main entrypoint, so `FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64` evaluated to `undefined.Base64` -> TypeError 'Cannot read property base64 of undefined'. Fix by main agent: (a) switched import to 'expo-file-system/legacy' which retains the old readAsStringAsync/writeAsStringAsync/cacheDirectory API, and (b) replaced `FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64` with the string literal 'base64' (which the legacy API accepts and which is future-proof against enum removal in /legacy too). Reproduction was not attempted since fix is already applied; verification confirms PDFs now download successfully on the web preview.
